text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While standing in line at the buffet to get lunch,
I spotted Silence Suzuka spacing out.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I'm sorry, I was spacing out.
I'm just... a little worn out...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Um... while jogging, I suddenly wondered how far
I'd have to run before everyone disappeared...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I just kept passing the people walking in front of me, and before I knew it, I—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I was jogging along a path beside some local train line.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...It was quite an ordeal getting back.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Perhaps having run a considerable distance,
Silence Suzuka looked rather exhausted."
